title: Assay result
description:
One sample's laboratory results: a row per sample carrying its analyte values in `elements[]`, each traceable to the method and certificate that produced it.

GENERATED from the normative OpenAPI document (`spec/openapi.yaml`) — do not edit by hand; run `python scripts/regenerate.py`. The OpenAPI document is normative for the wire; this file is the same contract for one record type, readable on its own.
x-generated-by: scripts/regenerate.py from spec/openapi.yaml (geoDB Open Exploration Protocol v0.1.0)

project.description: The project this assay belongs to, as an identity object rather than a bare id, so a reference stays meaningful across exports.

certificate.description: The lab job that created this row, as an identity object. On a merged row (one sample, two labs) the values may come from a different job — read the per-value `elements[].certificate` for provenance.

detection_limit_per_sample.description: Per-sample detection limit reported by the lab when a method has variable DL (Method.is_floating_dl=True). For BDL rows the AssayUnit stores value=-1 and this field carries the lab's reported '<X.XX' threshold.

precision_per_sample.description: Per-sample analytical precision (1-sigma error) reported by the lab. Drives the strip-log error whisker on the Au track for photon-assay samples. NULL for fixed-DL methods that only report a method-level precision.

analyte_mass_g.description: Actual sample mass loaded by the lab in grams. Distinct from the cutsheet's target mass — the lab reports what it really put on the instrument. Drives per-sample DL scaling on the photon-assay strip-log render.

lab_status_code.description:
Lab QC flag for this sample. BDL = below detection limit; HB / HET = heterogeneity flagged by lab (soft-warn, row imports normally); IS = insufficient sample (AssayUnit lands with value NULL); SNR = sample not received. Empty for samples with no flag.

* `BDL` - Below Detection Limit
* `HB` - Heterogeneity bias flagged by lab
* `HET` - Heterogeneous
* `IS` - Insufficient sample
* `SNR` - Sample not received

oneOf.description:
* `BDL` - Below Detection Limit
* `HB` - Heterogeneity bias flagged by lab
* `HET` - Heterogeneous
* `IS` - Insufficient sample
* `SNR` - Sample not received

value.description: The analyte value, as a DECIMAL STRING rather than a JSON number — precision is preserved exactly as the laboratory reported it, and parsing it as a float will silently round it. Parse it with a decimal type. Its units are the sibling `units` field: units are per VALUE, not per sample and not per element, because one sample can carry values from two laboratories at different units.

units.description: Units for this value (e.g. `ppm`, `ppb`, `pct`, `g/t`, `oz/ton`). Per value — always read it beside the value rather than assuming a project-wide unit.

detection_limit.description: A method limit in the value's own units, or null when the method declares none. A float, unlike `value`, which is a decimal string because it is what the laboratory reported.

upper_limit.description: A method limit in the value's own units, or null when the method declares none. A float, unlike `value`, which is a decimal string because it is what the laboratory reported.

method.description: The analytical method that produced this value, as an identity object. `is_floating_dl` says whether the detection limit is reported per sample rather than fixed by the method.

certificate.description: The lab job that produced THIS value. Differs from the row's certificate on a merged row; null when the value carries no stamp of its own and the row's job could not be resolved.
